preamble: Assibilation and voicing of the voiceless alveolar stop [t] to the voiced sibilant [z]. Hungarian z regularly corresponds to Proto-Uralic intervocalic *t, which Finnish and Estonian keep as t (alternating with d, s or zero) and Khanty keeps as t: Proto-Uralic *kota 'house' > ház, *käte 'hand' > kéz, *mete 'honey' > méz.
